jobs.title: Community Outreach Ambassador
jobs.description:
#### **ABH Riverside**

#### **Job Summary:**


The Outreach Ambassador – Homeless Services is a dynamic, field\-based role at Weingart Center, a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to ending homelessness in Los Angeles. This position blends community programming with direct outreach to individuals experiencing homelessness. Ambassadors facilitate wellness and educational activities for interim housing residents, while also engaging unhoused individuals in surrounding public areas. They work closely with LAHSA, LA County outreach teams, and site security to connect individuals to housing and support services. The role includes food distribution, documentation, caseload support, and assistance to the Program Manager in daily operations.


#### **Essential Functions:**


Conduct daily outreach in public areas, accompanied by site security, to engage unhoused individuals respectfully and safely



Walk designated routes with a clipboard to document interactions, needs, and housing interest



Complete intakes and assessments, and connect individuals to housing resources through LAHSA and partner agencies



Collaborate with LA County outreach coordinators to coordinate referrals and follow\-ups



Maintain an active caseload of 10–15 individuals, including both interim housing residents and outreach contacts



Conduct regular check\-ins to assess progress, update housing plans, and identify barriers to stability



Track client milestones such as document readiness, housing application status, and service referrals



Develop and lead monthly activity calendars (e.g., workshops, fitness, arts, life skills) for interim housing residents



Promote participation through flyers, announcements, and one\-on\-one engagement



Organize and distribute meals/snacks to residents and outreach contacts



Track food inventory and coordinate with vendors and volunteers for safe delivery



Maintain accurate case notes and documentation in HMIS/Clarity



Assist the Program Manager with administrative tasks, reporting, and coordination



Uphold trauma\-informed, harm\-reduction, and culturally competent practices in all interactions


#### **Required Qualifications:**


High school diploma or equivalent (Associate or Bachelor’s in social work, psychology, or related field preferred)



1–2 years of experience in outreach, social services, or activity coordination



Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage in diverse populations



Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, mental health challenges, or substance use preferred



Must be empathetic, observant, and able to advocate effectively



Food service training or certification required (e.g., ServSafe or equivalent)



CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain)



Willingness to complete training in Trauma\-Informed Care, De\-escalation, and Harm Reduction


#### **Physical \& Mental Requirements:**


Ability to walk long distances and stand for extended periods while conducting outreach



Capable of lifting up to 25 lbs. and performing physical tasks such as bending, reaching, and carrying supplies



Strong verbal communication, reading, writing, and decision\-making skills



Comfortable working indoors, outdoors, and in diverse urban environments



Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with face\-to\-face and verbal contact


#### **About WEINGART CENTER ASSOCIATION**


As one of the best comprehensive human services organizations in the western United States, Weingart Center is committed to removing barriers that keep people from housing. With multiple Interim and Permanent Supportive Housing solutions throughout the greater Los Angeles area, Weingart Center addresses the needs of seniors, Veterans, women, members of the LGBTQAI\+ community, the formerly incarcerated, and many others experiencing homelessness. All Weingart Center housing solutions include comprehensive wraparound services, which are designed to help clients overcome challenges and clear the way for a fulfilling life.

Description:

Air Treatment Corporation fosters a dynamic, collaborative work environment built on teamwork, exceptional customer service, and a commitment to excellence. We value our employees and are dedicated to supporting their professional growth by providing opportunities for development and advancement from within. Our comprehensive benefits package and supportive culture reflect our commitment to the success and well\-being of our team members.

**Job Summary:**


This is a field\-based sales position responsible for developing new business, expanding existing accounts, and building long\-term relationships with mechanical contractors, HVAC service companies, facility owners, maintenance departments, technicians, and purchasing professionals.


The Outside Parts Sales Representative will identify replacement and repair opportunities, conduct customer and jobsite visits, identify equipment and parts requirements, prepare quotations, and close sales. This position will work closely with our inside parts sales/counter team, warehouse, purchasing, and manufacturer partners to ensure customers receive the **right part, at the right price, and when they need it.**

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Develop and grow parts sales within an assigned territory (SoCal SD, LA, OC) by regularly calling on mechanical contractors, service/repair companies, facility maintenance departments, and other commercial HVAC end users.
* The Outside Parts Sales Representative is accountable for achieving established sales and gross profit objectives through territory development, new business generation, account growth, and consistent follow\-up on sales opportunities
* Identify replacement parts opportunities through jobsite visits, equipment surveys, and relationship\-building with technicians and purchasing contacts.
* Prepare and present accurate price quotes; follow up to close sales and meet or exceed monthly/annual sales targets.
* Maintain and expand relationships with existing accounts while actively prospecting new customers.
* Partner with the inside parts sales/counter team to source parts, check stock and lead times, and process orders accurately.
* Cross\-reference OEM part numbers and identify correct replacement parts across represented manufacturer lines.
* Communicate customer needs, competitive activity, and market trends back to the Parts Manager and manufacturer partners.
* Resolve customer issues (returns, warranty claims, order discrepancies) promptly and professionally.

**Company Description** **Social Media Manager**

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  

**Compensation:** $30–$40 per hour, DOE  

**Experience:** 3–5\+ years preferred


About the Brands


We are a growing fashion and lifestyle company seeking a creative, fashion\-driven, and results\-oriented **Social Media Manager** to lead the social media presence and growth of our brands:


About the Role


We are looking for a hands\-on Social Media Manager who understands fashion, social media culture, content creation, brand storytelling, and performance\-driven growth.


This is not a role focused solely on scheduling posts. The ideal candidate will take ownership of each brand's social media presence—from strategy and content planning to execution, community engagement, influencer coordination, paid social support, analytics, and growth.


You will work closely with our Design and E\-Commerce teams while taking primary ownership of social media strategy and day\-to\-day execution across multiple fashion and lifestyle brands.

 **Job Description** **Social Media Strategy \& Brand Management**

* Develop and execute distinct social media strategies for multiple fashion and lifestyle brands.
* Establish and maintain a clear, consistent social identity, voice, and visual direction for each brand.
* Create and manage monthly and weekly social media content calendars.
* Identify relevant fashion, lifestyle, cultural, and social media trends and translate them into brand\-appropriate content.

**Content Creation \& Execution**

* Plan and manage content across Instagram, Reels, Stories, TikTok, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.
* Create engaging short\-form content using available product, model, lifestyle, and behind\-the\-scenes assets.
* Coordinate with Design and E\-Commerce teams regarding new products, collections, seasonal campaigns, and key product launches.
* Write compelling, brand\-appropriate captions and social media copy.
* Coordinate product shoots and social content shoots as needed.
* Maintain a consistent and effective posting schedule across all brands.

**Community \& Influencer Management**

* Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, tags, mentions, and other customer engagement.
* Build relationships with followers and strengthen each brand's online community.
* Identify and coordinate with influencers, creators, and micro\-influencers.
* Support product seeding, creator collaborations, and influencer marketing initiatives.
* Track creator and influencer performance.

**Growth \& Paid Social**

* Develop strategies to increase qualified followers, engagement, website traffic, and conversions.
* Collaborate with the E\-Commerce team on Instagram and Facebook advertising, boosted posts, and social media campaigns.
* Test creative concepts, audiences, formats, and messaging to improve campaign performance.
* Identify high\-performing organic content that may be expanded through paid promotion.

**Analytics \& Reporting**

* Track and analyze weekly and monthly social media KPIs, including:


	+ Follower growth
	+ Reach and impressions
	+ Engagement rate
	+ Reels and video views
	+ Website traffic
	+ Conversion and sales, when measurable
	+ Top\-performing products and content
* Prepare concise weekly social media performance reports.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on performance data and trends.

 **Qualifications** **Must bilingual in Korean**

* 3–5\+ years of hands\-on social media management experience, preferably within fashion, apparel, beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook/Meta, and emerging social media platforms.
* Strong understanding of fashion trends, lifestyle content, social media culture, and young consumer behavior.
* Demonstrated experience growing social media audiences and increasing engagement.
* Experience creating short\-form video content, particularly Instagram Reels and TikTok.
* Strong visual judgment and understanding of fashion merchandising and brand storytelling.
* Excellent written communication and caption\-writing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands and projects while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of social media strategy and execution.


Preferred

* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar content creation tools.
* Understanding of Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager.
* Shopify or e\-commerce experience.
* Experience with influencer, creator, or affiliate marketing

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

El Pollo Loco is looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our marketing organization. This role owns traffic and workflow management across the marketing team, integrated agency team (IAT) and campaign activations — ensuring work moves smoothly from brief to execution to launch. You’ll will be instrumental in helping to create and manage our brand ambassador program, acting as the connective tissue between strategy and on\-the\-ground execution.
  
This is a great fit for someone who thrives on process, loves keeping cross\-functional teams aligned, and wants visibility across every marketing initiative from concept through launch.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Own end\-to\-end traffic and workflow management across the marketing organization, coordinating intake, prioritization, and timelines across the creative and content team and the broader marketing team.

* Build and maintain marketing operations systems — project tracking, resourcing, briefs, approvals — that keep teams aligned and reduce bottlenecks.
* Manage the brand ambassador program, including recruiting, onboarding, activation logistics, and performance tracking.
* Serve as a central point of contact for status updates, timeline changes, and resourcing conflicts across marketing initiatives.
* Identify and implement process improvements to increase team efficiency and campaign velocity.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. **Education/Work Experience:**  

* 3\-5\+ years of experience in marketing operations, project/traffic management, or a similar coordination\-heavy marketing role, ideally at the manager level.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with project management/traffic tools (Asana, Monday, Wrike, or similar).
* Strong communication and organizational skills; comfortable being the person who keeps everyone on track.
* A go\-getter mindset \- Proactively anticipates project needs, risks, and potential roadblocks—thinking several steps ahead to identify issues early and develop and present solutions before they impact the work.
* Experience managing ambassador, influencer, or field marketing programs is a plus.
* Retail, restaurant, or CPG marketing experience is a plus.


Our Company
  
  

In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus\-marinated, fire\-grilled pollo in town. jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Richmond & Pullman)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.  

  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/

 **The opportunity**


The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.
* Coordinate and oversee an after\-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Develop \& maintain partnerships with local providers.
* Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information \& referrals to access community resources and services.
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events
* Collect \& submit program outcomes data

**What you'll bring**

* Four years of experience in multi\-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Experience in:
* + after\-school programs or educational settings for youth
	+ serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self\-starter, multi\-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**
==============================

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
* CPR \& First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
* Successful completion of background check

**The details:**

* **This is a full\-time (32 hrs/wk), non\-exempt position and provides services at two sites.**
* **Schedule:** **Monday through Thursday, 9am\-5:30pm.** Ability to work occasional Saturday for an event. Schedule subject to change.
* **Location**:
* + Richmond Village: 700 S 26th St, Richmond, CA 94804
	+ Pullman Point: 2801 Pullman Ave, Richmond, CA 94804
* **Wage:** $28/hr
* **Benefits offered**:
* + Health insurance, dental insurance, term life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Additionally, the following voluntary benefits are available at 100% employee cost: vision insurance, voluntary life insurance, pet insurance, and supplemental benefits.
	+ Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match
	+ Paid time off \+ 14 paid holidays

  

Project Access, Inc. is an at\-will and equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace. We value diversity in all its forms and actively seek to build a team that reflects the richness of our community. Our hiring practices are designed to identify and welcome talented individuals regardless of their race, ethnicity, cultural background, religious beliefs or practices, gender identity or expression, relationship status, age, neurotype, physical or sensory abilities, sexual orientation, military service history, or any other aspect of their identity protected by law. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, more innovative solutions, and a stronger community impact. Our goal is to foster an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives and skills.

 **Project****Access****participates****in****E\-****Verify**

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

28 \- 28 USD per hour(Richmond Village \- CA)

jobs.title: Fixed-Term Marketing Division Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Fixed\-Term Administrative Coordinator for the Marketing division works closely with the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and Directors of the Marketing Division to support the overall coordination of strategic division initiatives and overall administrative support for the Division.  

In addition to providing administrative support to the CMO and Directors of the Marketing division, the Administrative Coordinator serves as coordinator for division projects and will take on specific duties assigned by the CMO.


This is a 6\-month fixed\-term position, from approximately mid\-October 2026 \- mid\-April 2027\. The application deadline is Sunday, September 13, 2026, 9 PM PST. **Duties and Responsibilities:**


1\. Provides administrative support to the entire Marketing division by scheduling meetings, preparing presentations, aggregating research, responding to accounting and human resource administrative needs, tracking strategic projects, contract trafficking and other division workflows. Drafts internal and external correspondence. Proactively anticipates future needs based on the upcoming events, meetings, deadlines, and other activities.


2\. Under direction of the Chief Marketing Officer, serves as the key coordinator for the Brand Identity project: scheduling meetings and tracking deliverables for internal teams and with the external agency partner. Prepares materials to support project milestones. Writes briefs and summarizes feedback at key project milestones. Prepares summary decks. Communicates directly with the agency and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and project advancement. Coordinates calendaring and sharing of information for stakeholder input sessions and cross\-functional progress share outs. Tracks project SOW and timeline to ensure project’s overall success.


3\. Processes invoices and departmental expense reports; create purchase orders; assists with budget tracking Maintains and updates project flow in Asana, adds new tasks related to key projects, tracks overall progress and communicates with the team to ensure project milestones are met.


4\. Manages division Asana project integration into the workflow and planning process.


5\. Serves as project coordinator for division\-wide brand projects and marketing related inputs for Trustees and Board meetings. Prepares agendas and distributes meeting materials May attend meetings and take meetings and assign follow up action items for key projects.


6\. Delivers status reports for key projects and strategic initiatives across the division and, as relevant, to cross functional teams. Compiles insights into presentable, actionable reports for key stakeholders.


7\. Facilitates project advancement across the division by shepherding key documents and approvals through the division workflow, especially as related to milestone reporting for strategic initiatives, the brand project, and review of contracts or content for curatorial and legal review. Facilitates aggregating data and insights for third party reporting.


8\. Coordinates the Marketing Board Committee preparation, aggregating inputs and presentation needs, day of facilitation and drafting of minutes.


9\. Helps facilitate Marketing Division\-specific onboarding and offboarding procedures for new or departing division employees.


10\. Assists in all Marketing \& Communications department events, including press previews, social influencer meet\-ups, audience cultivation, and partnership events. Provides cross functional event planning coordination.


11\. Assists in assembling post\-exhibition marketing campaign reports and campaign analytics. Coordinates with media agency and the broader marketing division to aggregate data and insights into institutional archives.


12\. Updates project schedules in Asana to help teams meet deadlines; assists and coordinates production timelines to ensure timely distribution of materials.


13\. Performs light clerical duties (photocopying, filing, mailing).


14\. Performs other duties as assigned.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Liberal Arts or a closely related field from an accredited college or university.


Work Experience: Minimum of three years of office administration experience.


Skills and Abilities:

* Proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office Suite, project management tools, and customer relationship management systems (CRMs).
* Proficiency in Asana as a project management tool
* Knowledge of marketing \+ communications best practices.
* Excellent organizational, writing, and communication skills.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective and appropriate working relationships.
* Ability to take direction, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and take initiative.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, tact, and diplomacy.
* Flexibility in meeting shifting demands and priorities.
* Knowledge of art preferred.


Additional:

  

Schedule: This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Hybrid schedules are a minimum of 4 days a week onsite, with the understanding that schedules may change based on operational needs. The workweek is Monday \- Friday, 8 hours a day, 40 hours per week. from approximately mid\-October 2026 \- mid\-April 2027\.


Compensation: This is a union position eligible for the Museums' benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance and a generous time off package. There is a 7\-step union pay scale for this position: Step 1 (starting rate) is $34\.18, Step 7 (max rate) is $45\.80\. Generally, new employees start at the beginning of the pay scale.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
PagerDuty (NYSE:PD) is a leader in Digital Operations Management. In an always\-on world, organizations of all sizes trust PagerDuty to help them deliver a perfect digital experience to their customers, every time. Teams use PagerDuty to identify issues and opportunities in real time and bring together the right people to fix problems faster and prevent them in the future. Over 13,000 organizations (including 60 of Fortune 100\) rely on PagerDuty to succeed with Digital Transformation, Cloud Migration, and DevOps Modernization. Notable customers include GE, Cisco, Genentech, Electronic Arts, Cox Automotive, Netflix, Shopify, Zoom, DoorDash, Lululemon and more. We are expanding rapidly as a platform for Digital Operations Management using AI/ML and Automation and growing our adoption by Development, IT, Customer Service, Security, and other teams across the organization.

**Event Marketing Manager**

  


**Role Overview**:



PagerDuty is seeking an Event Marketing Manager to join our diverse, customer\-focused team! This role will report directly to the Director of Event Marketing for North America within the Revenue Marketing \& Operations department. As the Event Marketing Manager, you will be a strategic thinker with excellent project management skills, leading the planning and execution of both PagerDuty hosted and 3rd party sponsored events. You will be responsible for developing our event and trade show strategy to ensure alignment with PagerDuty's OKRs, and have a proven track record of successfully partnering with GTM teams to achieve revenue\-based goals through integrated event programs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in planning and executing both small and large\-scale events that contribute to pipeline creation, expand customer acquisition, and grow the PagerDuty brand.

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**:


* Develop and implement comprehensive event and trade show strategies aligned with the company's marketing and business objectives.
* Oversee the planning and execution of event programs across both hosted and 3rd party sponsored events, including logistics, vendor management, staffing, and on\-site management
* Collaborate with cross\-functional marketing, sales, and product teams to align on event objectives and create impactful experiences.
* Source and manage vendor and agency relationships as it pertains to event planning and execution: vendors, venues, booth partners, design, video, and more
* Develop enablement tools and resources to empower Sales and Customer Success teams to hit registration targets and achieve executive meeting goals
* Monitor and evaluate event performance against key metrics, collecting and analyzing data to measure success and identify areas for improvement.
* Communicate event plans, progress, and outcomes to senior management and key stakeholders.

  


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**


* At least 7 years of previous experience in a marketing, sales, or customer\-facing role within a fast\-growing organization
* 5\+ years experience in B2B event management with proven experience leading, project managing, and executing large multi\-faceted events
* A data\-driven approach to decision\-making utilizing Salesforce, Tableau, or similar tools

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Incredible organization and project management skills to manage multiple events tasks, vendors, and stakeholders simultaneously
* Clear and effective communication skills to interface with team members, stakeholders, vendors, and attendees.
* Ability to build strong cross\-functional relationships and rally project teams.
* Demonstrated ability to set strategic direction, including evaluation of event performance against key metrics for learnings and optimization
* Proficiency in G\-Suite, Salesforce, Tableau, Splash, Cvent, Asana, or Monday
* Experience managing budgets and forecasting spend
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment
* Strong negotiation skills and experience managing vendor relationships and contracts
  


**SALARY RANGE:** $127,000 to $191,4000

**Hesitant to apply?**



We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn't the right role or time \- sign up for job alerts!


**Where we work**



PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we **cannot** employ candidates residing in:


**Location restrictions:**  

**Australia:** Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia  

**Canada:** Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon  

**United States:** Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming  

*Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.*


**How we work**



Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.



People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

Proofpoint is a global leader in human\- and agent\-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**


At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem\-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact


We seek an experienced Account Manager to join our growing Commercial Add\-On team based out of our Sunnyvale office. In this role you will focus on expanding our product footprint with our existing customer base. By joining our already successful team, you will be an instrumental part of our consistent year over year revenue growth!


Your day\-to\-day

* This is a Hybrid role requiring you to be in the Sunnyvale office 4 days a week. Monday\-Thursday.
* The Account Manager will be responsible for working with our existing customers in a consultative manner to identify additional solutions from the Proofpoint portfolio
* Drive the entire sales process from start to finish including opportunity identification, introductory meetings, product demonstration, customer Q\&A, as well as negotiation and closing
* Develop, customize, and utilize effective close plans to navigate and manage the sales process
* Team up with our world class Sales Engineering team to devise and execute account strategies and plans


• Engage with our rapidly expanding channel partner network to educate, inform, and drive incremental revenue • Interact with the management team in 1\-1, team meetings and via forecasting and reporting to provide critical updates, and strategic account planning

* Provide outstanding and high touch customer service, including escalation and coordination of support issues as needed
* Become a perpetual student of Proofpoint products, and the ever\-changing Cybersecurity industry!
* You can achieve your quota, but quite frankly we would love you to blow it out of the water!
* May require modified work hours to cover accounts in other time zones, and occasional travel for key accounts What you bring to the team
* Minimum 3 years of solution sales experience, focused on generating net new or add\-on revenue
* Must have experience selling to the C\-suite, extensive experience selling to CISO, CIO, CTO preferred
* Consistent track record of meeting and/or exceeding quota goals
* Experience managing longer sales cycles (2\-6 months) from prospecting stage through negotiation and closing
* Experience or training in established sales methodologies such as SPIN, Sandler, Miller Heiman, Value Selling or The Challenger Sale is preferred
* Competitive nature, operating within a team environment
* Ability to present and discuss highly technical information, as well as aptitude to learn new concepts quickly
* Strong presentation skills, both in person and via phone/online
* Security or SaaS sales experience a plus
* Capable of providing great customer care while continuing to identify new revenue opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience


\#LI\-JD1

**Why Proofpoint?**


At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us:

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities

 **Our Culture:**


Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success\-every day, for everyone.


We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information\- we can’t wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who is Golden West Packaging Group (GWPG)?**
We are a leading West Coast mill\-independent specialty packaging and printing business. We are the people behind the innovative packaging solutions that make it possible for our customers’ products to reach our community – at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between.
With 13 manufacturing facilities primarily in California and Washington state, our extensive production capabilities include structural and graphic design, value\-added converting, flexographic printing, and lithographic lamination. Our advanced, environmentally sustainable packaging solutions serve a wide range of well\-known customer brands across multiple industries including agriculture, food services, medical device, food products, wineries, high tech, pharma, cosmetics and many more!
**Why is Golden West Packaging Group THE place to work?**
We are a well\-established, growing company in a stable industry that is re\-imagining itself to be a place where everyone knows everyone, where you can make a difference, and where you can learn and grow professionally.
We are focused on safety and building an employee\-centric work environment where team members can experience camaraderie, relevance, and career advancement.
As the packaging and logistics sector continues to grow, we’re growing with it and creating new opportunities. Come make your mark at a company that strives to celebrate your individuality, skills, and talents.
At Golden West Packaging Group, you’ll feel the difference and make a difference**The Role You’ll Play**
The primary responsibility of the person in this position is to strategically grow sales and increase the Golden West (GW)’s profitability by developing, leading, and driving the GWPG sales strategy to identify and gain sales contracts that benefit the customer and advance Golden West profitable business growth strategies.
**What You’ll Do*** Identify and target new business opportunities through strategic prospecting, market research and networking
* Conduct sales presentations, pitches, and product demonstrations to showcase our packaging solutions
* Collaborate with other team members on the development of customized packaging products and service solutions to increase customer satisfaction and optimize GW’s sales profitability within a given product or market category.
* Generate new business opportunities in assigned categories to grow sales and increase Golden West’s market share
* Forecast sales projections, track performance metrics, and provide regular reports to management
* Stay current to market and customer trends and developments for given categories to identify new sales opportunities to expand existing customer sales volumes and new sales opportunities
* Ensure sales meet contributions margin requirements and ensure GW’s business sustainability
* Develop strategies to expand GW’s business and profitability
* Research competition and business climate for category to identify and mitigate risk of potential business threats and to optimize potential business opportunities
* Serve as the primary point of contact for existing customers, building strong relationships and understanding their needs
* Define business plans and strategies for assigned category to gain market share and maximize profitability and execute against such strategies to achieve plans




**What You’ll Get*** A friendly, team\-based, supportive work environment
* Competitive total compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, vision, dental, life insurance, and 401K plan with employer contribution
* Employee Assistance coverage with full services, including dietary and nutritional services, retirement planning and support services
* 10 paid holidays per year
* Paid time off
* Progressive employee referral program
* Professional development and career growth opportunities


If this sounds like you and if you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, we invite you to apply today!
**What You’ll Need****Required skills, knowledge and abilities:*** Effective sales skills using a data\-based, solution sales approach
* Proven track record of successful selling
* Strong organizational skills, discipline and attention to detail
* Customer focused mentality and approach to business
* Expert knowledge and understanding of industry packaging needs and solutions
* Strong verbal and written communications skills
* Proven analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong collaboration, interpersonal and relationship building skills

**Required education and experience:*** B.S/A. in business administration or related field
* 5\+ years of experience in sales and solutions sales with a proven track record of success
* Experience in packaging industry is desired


Golden West Packaging Group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.
California Pay Transparency Disclaimer: This is an Exempt position. The pay range for this position is $90,000\.00 to $135,000\.00\. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. Actual placement within range will be contingent upon several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, education, experience, internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hornblower Group is a global leader in experience and transportation. Spanning a 100\-year history, Hornblower Group’s portfolio of international offerings includes water\- and land\-based experiences and ferry and transportation services. City Experiences, Hornblower Group’s premier experience division, offers dining and sightseeing cruises and walking and food tours through the City Cruises, Walks, and Devour brands. City Ferry, part of Hornblower Group’s Ferry and Transportation Division, is the largest private operator of high\-speed passenger and vehicle ferries in the United States, carrying more than 10 million passengers annually and operating services including NYC Ferry, Puerto Rico Ferry, and other regional ferry systems. Hornblower Group’s subsidiaries include Hornblower Marine, which provides vessel outhaul and maintenance services at Bridgeport Boatworks in Bridgeport, Connecticut, and Seaward Services, Inc., a full\-service shipping, waterfront logistics and management company that specializes in the operation and maintenance of government and commercial vessels. Additionally, Anchor Operating System, LLC, a Hornblower Group subsidiary and independent entity, provides reservation, ticketing and website integration services for clients in the transportation, tourism and entertainment industries. Today, Hornblower Group’s global portfolio covers over 10 countries, over 50 U.S. cities and serves more than 20 million guests annually. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, Hornblower Group’s additional corporate offices reside in San Francisco, California; Boston, Massachusetts; Chicago, Illinois; London, United Kingdom; New York, New York; Dublin, Ireland; and across Ontario, Canada. For more information, visit hornblowercorp.com.
  
  

**Position Summary:**  

The successful Account Manager will establish Alcatraz Cruises as the iconic San Francisco experience.
  
They thrive in a fast\-paced environment, take initiative, and are driven to identify new business opportunities and exceed sales goals. They possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, are confident engaging with diverse clients and partners, and demonstrate a solutions\-oriented mindset. The right person is organized, adaptable, and collaborative, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a positive and professional attitude. A commitment to teamwork, accountability, and delivering results is essential.
  
**Pay Structure:** $20 \- $36/Hourly Base Rate \+ 7% Commission with no cap \- as the first outbound sales rep for Alcatraz, your earning potential is limitless!
  
  

**Duties and Responsibilities:****Sales Focus:**  

* Develops a comprehensive knowledge of the client and market needs, supported by regularly visiting the clients and setting up face\-to\-face appointments.
* Generates leads, primarily by using high closing rate techniques such as client appointments and networking through current customers for lead generation.
* Identifies and converts prospects to clients by using proven sales processes and approaches.
* Regularly attends networking events and other in\-person industry events to learn more about their market.
* Identifies customer needs and uses in\-depth product knowledge to prepare winning proposals.
* Convincingly presents proposals in\-person during site inspections and face to face meetings.
* Handles objections and solves customer problems, through active listening techniques and by regularly consulting with sales leadership.
* Establishes relationships with associations and business organizations (e.g. Convention \& Visitors Bureau, Department of Education, Tour Operators, etc) by regularly visiting these extensions of our sales team and gaining referrals in the process.


**Administrative:**  

* Ability to effectively plan out a schedule for the week, with a focus on closing revenue and executing out of office sales activities including client visits, networking events, ship tours and boarding client events.
* Uses Salesforce (CRM software) to effectively plan and manage the activities in the assigned markets and totrack productivity of these sales activities.
* Uses Anchor (reservation software) to accurately book orders and to create curated proposals.
* Maintains proper personal organization; manages time well, sets appropriate work priorities, and maintains accurate records.
* Works with the Sales Admin to collect payments; maintains accounts receivable within ageing guidelines.


**Customer Service:**  

* Ensures prompt responses to client inquiries, with a goal of getting a quote to the client within 24 hours.
* Ensure complete and accurate product details are communicated to the operations team to ensure proper execution of product promised.
* Follows up with customer within 24 hours after the cruise to further develop the account, while thanking the client for their business, asking for a survey to be completed and if possible, obtaining referrals from the client.
* Works with Operational leaders to resolve all customer issues, while making sure that high priority issues are handled in\-person.


**Other:**  

* Attending applicable meetings as designated or necessary.
* Other duties as assigned by operations leaders.


**Requirements \& Qualifications:**  

* A minimum of 2 years total sales experience consisting of at least 1\-year outbound telephone sales experience.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred in related field or related experience.
* Tourism hospitality experience preferred.
* Proficient with Microsoft office products as well as CRM software.
* Analytical skills required to identify and exploit selling opportunities and large scale partnerships.
* Proposal writing is required, must communicate effectively in written form.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships as required by job responsibility.
* Must have the ability to persuade and influence people.
* Must have proven leadership skills.
* Must be able to listen effect

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT INKHOUSE**



Inkhouse is part of Orchestra, a strategic communications and marketing company built for today's complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700\+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy\-first political media team. Learn more at www.orchestraco.com.



People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high\-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.


**ABOUT THIS ROLE**



Inkhouse is seeking an Account Manager to lead day\-to\-day client relations and drive strategy across a portfolio of technology clients. This is an opportunity for someone who pairs expert tactical execution with a real point of view on strategy — someone who can run the work while shaping where it's going.



The Account Manager will ideally have experience across B2B and consumer technology, integrated communications spanning earned, owned and social, and a track record of high\-priority media relations. This person will be a team player who keeps accounts moving to help clients achieve their goals. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about contributing to company culture and who invest in teaching junior staff and in growing their careers.


**Role location:** This role is based in our San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA, or San Diego, CA office on a hybrid basis, in\-office 2\-3 days in the office per week.


**ACCOUNTABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS**



As an Account Manager at Inkhouse, you will…


* Lead day\-to\-day client relations and support senior leadership in strategic planning, problem\-solving, and crisis mitigation.
* Drive project management and account logistics, setting the tone for client meetings and making team assignments.
* Execute high\-priority media relations and feature pitching across broadcast, print, and online channels.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key media outlets and industry analysts.
* Draft core client materials including messaging documents, strategic plans, and memos.
* Develop thought leadership content, bylines, blog posts, and integrated communications content across channels.
* Oversee quality control by reviewing team documents, speaking abstracts, awards submissions and analyst materials.
* Mentor and train junior staff, delegating tasks effectively while managing upward to team leadership.
* Monitor industry trends to drive proactive media outreach and champion company values.


**Essential skills:**


* 5\-7 years of Public Relations experience, ideally at an agency
* Direct experience in B2B or consumer technology
* Must be passionate and interested in working on tech accounts, demonstrating enthusiasm and expertise
* Ability to think through communication strategies and deliver tangible results
* Proven track record pitching across a variety of mediums, with a focus on strategic media relations and results
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Ability to multitask easily in a fast\-paced environment while paying close attention to details
* Demonstrated experience supporting account leadership, including managing workstreams, guiding junior staff, and contributing to strategic planning and execution
* Ability to work both independently and in a dynamic, team\-oriented atmosphere
* Comfortable managing multiple clients and meeting strict deadlines


**WORKING AT ORCHESTRA**


**Salary range** (commensurate with experience and skills): $85,000\-$115,000

  

\#LI\-KM1  

\#LI\-Hybrid

  


Orchestra is the first communications company built for today's media landscape. Since 2022, it's acquired nine firms, including: BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communication professionals. Learn more at: www.orchestraco.com.

jobs.title: E-commerce Account Manager
jobs.description:
Verenigde Staten
San Francisco
As E\-commerce Account Manager, you are responsible for the day\-to\-day management and growth of our U.S. E\-commerce business, encompassing Amazon, Walmart, and other retail platforms. You will achieve commercial goals by ensuring content optimization, excellent campaign execution, and sales\-driving activities that are fully aligned with our brand strategy and customer needs. Reporting to the Head of Sales Natural Foods, you are a key member of the U.S. Sales Team, collaborating closely with marketing, category, and global eCommerce colleagues to accelerate our digital growth. Taking full ownership of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, pricing, and portal operations, the Account Manager will ensure strategies are tailored to each platform, executed with precision, and aligned with Lotus’s overall business objectives. This role combines strategic and operational responsibilities to optimize the company’s digital presence, enhance brand visibility, and drive revenue growth. You will own platform health, oversee retail media planning, and translate insights into actionable strategies that drive revenue, expand distribution, and increase market share.
  
### **Functiebeschrijving**

Daily Operations \& Platform Management:* Lead daily e\-commerce operations across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Target, Thrive, Safeway, and Kroger platforms.
* Conduct content and PDP audits, and manage Brand Store updates.
* Maintain scorecards, and pacing tools (including MTD pacing, weekly order review, forecast, and finance check\-ins).


Commercial Planning \& Financial Management:* Collaborate on promotional planning and ensure strong execution
* Support trade spend tracking, true\-ups, and TPM checkbook analysis.
* Own account forecasting and operational troubleshooting in close partnership with the supply chain team


Paid Media \& Advertising:* Partner with internal teams and external agencies (e.g., Tinuiti, Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Target) to plan, launch, and optimize paid search, DSP, and retail media campaigns.
* Manage media planning and strategy (annual/monthly plans, ROAS targets, budget splits, ecommerce scorecard).
* Execute campaign setup and launch across platforms.
* Perform optimization and bid management (keyword targeting, budget reallocation, ACoS goals).
* Leverage Amazon Marketing Cloud for insights and advanced targeting (audience testing).
* Conduct search terms analysis for trends and insights applicable to paid search strategy.
* Review Amazon AMS spend pacing and adjust strategy as needed.
* Perform paid search campaign optimization for Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Thrive, and Target.
* Review DSP ads and conduct pulse checks.


Reporting, Insights \& Communication:* Prepare and deliver weekly, monthly, and global business recaps.
* Provide detailed performance insights, visualizations, and actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking (SOV, media trends, category performance).
* Communicate campaign impact and partner with internal teams and stakeholders.
* Refresh monthly Amazon Ads and Walmart Ads performance recaps for global connects.


Strategy \& Innovation:* Pilot new retail media formats and explore beta features.
* Develop audience strategies using 1P/retailer data.
* Support A/B testing (creative tests, placements tests, dayparting).
* Analyze search term reports, category trends, and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and inform content, pricing, and media strategies.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Relationships:* Coordinate with brand (global/local), insights, and category teams for media plan alignment.
* Work cross\-functionally with marketing and creative to request content updates for key seasons, new item launches, and ad hoc as needed.
* Build strong relationships with platform partners ensuring deliverables and opportunities are leveraged.
### **Profiel**

* Proven experience (4\-6 years) in e\-commerce account management, with a track record of managing multiple accounts and platforms ideally within CPG
* Expertise in e\-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, and Costco, with advanced knowledge of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, penalties, and pricing.
* Strong analytical skills to assess campaign performance and make data\-driven decisions.
* Demonstrated success in managing cross\-platform advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for performance.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Proficiency in Excel or similar tools for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven ability to optimize product listings and manage compliance responsibilities on Amazon.

  
### **Aanbod**

To be determined.

**Tri Valley Striping LLC**  
Fremont, CA / Bay Area

The YMCA of Greater New York is here for all New Yorkers — to empower youth, improve health, and strengthen community. * Actively participate in training sessions, designated meetings, and special events.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Brooklyn, NY  

**Schedule:** Full\-time, on\-site \| Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  

**Salary:** $60,000–$70,000  

**Reports to:** Director of E\-Commerce Operations

**The Role**
------------


We are looking for an organized, analytical, and dependable **E\-Commerce Operations Coordinator** to support our growing e\-commerce business across Amazon (1P), Walmart, Target\+, Wayfair, and other major marketplaces.


This is an entry\-level role with the opportunity to grow into meaningful responsibility. You will help manage projects, product listings, reporting, inventory, and cross\-team follow\-up. We will train the right person, but we expect strong attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and consistent ownership.


You’ll get a front\-row view of what it takes to operate a nine\-figure e\-commerce business and gain hands\-on experience with the systems, processes, and teams that keep it running behind the scenes.


For someone who is early in their career and interested in e\-commerce, operations, analytics, or marketplace management, this is an opportunity to learn the business from the ground up while working directly with an experienced e\-commerce team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Track projects, deadlines, action items, and follow\-ups across internal and overseas teams.
* Create, update, and maintain accurate product listings across multiple e\-commerce marketplaces.
* Review product pricing, images, descriptions, specifications, and other listing information for accuracy.
* Analyze sales, inventory, and product performance reports to help identify trends and potential issues.
* Support inventory planning and help ensure appropriate product availability across marketplaces.
* Assist with new product launches and marketplace setup.
* Maintain spreadsheets, reports, trackers, and process documentation.
* Research listing, inventory, pricing, and operational issues and help coordinate solutions.
* Communicate updates and follow up with team members to keep projects moving.
* Help identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and day\-to\-day e\-commerce operations.
* Support the Director of E\-Commerce Operations with additional projects and initiatives as needed.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
* Analytical and comfortable working with numbers, data, and spreadsheets.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Reliable, proactive, and able to follow through on assignments.
* Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working and communicating with multiple teams.
* Quick to learn new systems, processes, and technology.
* Able to research problems, think critically, and work toward solutions.
* Comfortable working independently while also collaborating as part of a team.

**Experience**
--------------


Previous e\-commerce or marketplace experience is helpful, but **not required**.


Experience with Amazon Vendor Central, Walmart, Target\+, Wayfair, or similar platforms is a plus, but we are willing to train someone who demonstrates strong organizational skills, analytical ability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role?**
----------------------------------


This position is a great fit for someone who is early in their career and wants more than just a traditional entry\-level job. You may not know everything about e\-commerce yet—and that's okay.


We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out, notices when something doesn't look right, follows through without needing constant reminders, and isn't afraid to ask questions and learn.


As you develop your knowledge of our marketplaces, products, systems, and operations, you'll have the opportunity to take on greater ownership and broader operational responsibility.


If you're organized, curious, comfortable with data, and excited to learn how a large e\-commerce business operates behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
### **About Veho**

  

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

  

We are building a modern, end\-to\-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever\-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  



Powered by next\-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post\-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like Hello Fresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

  

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit\-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities.


**About the Role**
------------------


Veho is seeking an Account Managerto manage and support a book of Enterprise and Mid\-Market accounts, responsible for the full spectrum of the client relationship, from day\-to\-day operational excellence to long\-term strategic growth.


This is a hybrid role that blends the tactical rigor of account operations with the strategic mindset of client success. The Account Managerwill manage account health, run client meetings, prepare Quarterly Business Reviews, monitor performance, and solve client needs as they arise. At the same time, they will develop and execute account plans and growth strategies, working to expand Veho's footprint within each account over time.


Veho is a fast\-paced, high\-growth company, and the Account Managerwill be a builder \- intentionally crafting the ideal client experience. They will regularly encounter problems that have never been solved before, and their job will be to write the playbook, galvanize cross\-functional support, and execute.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Account Ownership \& Client Partnership:** Support and manage a book of Enterprise and Mid\-Market accounts, serving as a main point of contact both externally with the client and internally across Veho teams. Ensure each account runs smoothly, stays healthy, and fosters a strong sense of partnership.
* **Retention, Growth \& Client Satisfaction:** Own net revenue retention and account growth targets for your book of business. Drive expansion by identifying and executing on opportunities within existing accounts. Champion client satisfaction, measured by client NPS scores.
* **Strategic Account Planning:** Understand each account deeply, mapping out account plans, identifying growth opportunities, and building and executing strategies to expand revenue and deepen the client relationship over time.
* **Client Engagement \& Partnership Health:** Run weekly client meetings, prepare and deliver Quarterly Business Reviews, and proactively monitor account health using internal dashboards, performance data, and client feedback.
* **Operational Problem\-Solving:** Act as the connective tissue between the client and Veho's internal teams — including Ground Operations, Transportation, Product, and Engineering — to resolve issues, manage escalations, and ensure seamless service delivery.

**Program Coordinator**  

*Southern Regional Education Board (SREB) \| Atlanta, GA (Hybrid) \| Full\-Time, Exempt*  

SREB is looking for a Program Coordinator who enjoys being the person who keeps things moving — the one who tracks the deadline nobody else caught, keeps the contact list current, drafts a clean first pass of the agenda, and makes sure offsite meetings or trainings run without a hitch. If you take real pride in dependable, detail\-oriented follow\-through and want to support meaningful work in education policy, we invite you to apply for our team.**ABOUT SREB**


The Southern Regional Education Board is a nonpartisan, interstate compact that helps its member states improve education from early childhood through doctoral education and into the workforce. SREB does this through reliable data, practical support for implementation, and cross\-state collaboration — producing research, state comparisons, data services, and publications that policymakers and practitioners use every day.**POSITION DETAILS**

* SREB is hiring two Program Coordinators. Both openings will be filled from the same applicant pool — the two strongest candidates will be selected.
* These positions are grant\-funded, with current funding running through December 2029 or July 2031, depending on the grant supporting each position. Additional grants may extend anticipated employment beyond those dates.
* These positions have a hybrid schedule that currently requires working in our mid\-town Atlanta office every Monday and Tuesday and remotely Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. When working remotely, you must be available and free from distractions for the same working hours as in\-office days. You may be required to report to the office other days as needed for business purposes, however, this is infrequent for this role.

**ABOUT THE WORK**


This is a coordination and administrative\-support role assigned to one of SREB's program areas. You'll be the linchpin for the program — organizing meetings and events, maintaining records and contacts, compiling data for reports and proposals, and helping produce clear, well\-edited written materials. You will work closely with a program manager and team in achieving the grant deliverables. It's an individual\-contributor role for someone who finds real satisfaction in doing coordination and support work well and where consistent work is genuinely valued.**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Coordinate the processes, reports, and agreements that keep the program area running smoothly.
* Compile and organize data for reporting, including charts and tables for annual reports.
* Help plan and coordinate meetings, conferences, and workshops, including logistics with other SREB staff and partner organizations.
* Serve as a point of contact for program members and partners, answering questions by phone and email.
* Assist with producing presentations, reports, newsletters, flyers, and other materials.
* Maintain an accurate, up\-to\-date contacts database for the program.
* Maintain relationships with program members, partners, participants, and state agencies.
* Partner with the program manager and Communications staff on website content and e\-communications.
* Contribute ideas and support to strengthen how the team serves its members and partners.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Required:*** Two to four years of project management or administrative support experience.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several ongoing tasks and deadlines at once.
* Comfort working independently day to day, with regular check\-ins rather than close supervision.
* Clear, accurate writing and editing skills for presentations, reports, and correspondence.
* A professional, easygoing manner with people from a wide range of backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel data functions as well as solid working knowledge of standard office software; comfort learning program\-specific tools.
* Ability to travel overnight.
* Ability to create Google forms with QR codes for meeting or training sign\-in.

**Helpful, but not required:*** Ability to support large\-group Zoom or MS Teams meetings, including breakout rooms
* Event planning experience preferred
* Grant experience preferred

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Starting salary for this position begins at $50,000\.
* Continuous improvement mindset. Every day is an opportunity to grow. Employees are set up to succeed in a workplace that supports continuous learning and development as part of a lifelong journey of achievement.
* Mission and Social Impact that reaches across the nation. SREB focuses on helping states improve education from early childhood through postsecondary and the workforce. Together, we’re shaping stronger futures for students and economies across the South, and the nation.
* Medical, dental and vision
* Life and short\-term disability insurance
* Flexible spending and health savings account options (FSA/HSA)
* Health reimbursement account (HRA)
* Additional voluntary life and long\-term disability options
* Very generous leave programs
* Outstanding 403b retirement plan

**WHY THIS ROLE**

* Steady, well\-organized work that directly supports SREB's mission across member states.
* A collaborative program team and a manager who will set direction and priorities with you.
* A respected, mission\-driven organization with a long track record in Southern education.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

LeaderPass is looking for a smart, organized, proactive early\-career professional who wants real responsibility.

This is not a traditional social media coordinator role.

You’ll work directly with the founder and our team across content, social media, client operations, AI\-assisted workflows, Blueprint Sessions, and production. You’ll help decide what needs to happen next, keep projects moving, turn conversations and ideas into usable content, and make sure important details do not get lost.

We are looking for someone who learns quickly, communicates well, notices what needs attention, and takes ownership without waiting to be reminded.

This is a full\-time, in\-person position at our Peachtree Corners studio.

**What You’ll Do**

**Own the Content Rhythm**

* Help manage the content calendar for LeaderPass and founder Jamie Minton across LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Shorts, and other relevant channels.
* Identify ideas from meetings, Blueprint Sessions, film days, transcripts, client conversations, and existing content.
* Help determine what should be filmed, written, repurposed, edited, or published next.
* Coordinate editors, graphics, thumbnails, captions, approvals, and publishing.
* Capture approved behind\-the\-scenes content during studio and client work.
* Watch performance and engagement and bring recommendations about what we should repeat, change, expand, or stop.

**Keep Clients and Projects Moving**

* Follow up on missing information, approvals, decisions, deadlines, and next steps.
* Prepare clients for Blueprint Sessions, filming, and other LeaderPass experiences.
* Keep project status organized and flag potential problems before they become problems.
* Communicate professionally with clients, partners, and team members.
* Close loops rather than waiting for someone else to remember them.

**Work With AI and the LeaderPass Process**

* Prepare transcripts, source materials, notes, and client information for approved AI workflows.
* Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and LeaderPass systems to help create strong first drafts and organize information.
* Check AI\-generated work against original source material rather than assuming it is correct.
* Identify missing decisions, inconsistencies, or things that need human judgment.
* Help move approved work from ideas through production, placement, visibility, and delivery.

**Be Part of Production**

* Participate in selected Blueprint Sessions, film days, and client experiences.
* Help keep assets, schedules, notes, versions, and decisions organized.
* Learn how expertise gets turned into content, experiences, and digital products.

**What We’re Looking For**

You do not need ten years of experience.

We care more about **how you think and work**.

We’re looking for someone who:

* Writes and communicates well.
* Has strong instincts around content and social media.
* Is organized and dependable.
* Follows through on details.
* Is comfortable communicating with clients and executives.
* Learns new technology quickly.
* Is curious about AI and willing to experiment with new tools.
* Can take feedback without becoming defensive.
* Brings recommendations instead of only asking what to do next.
* Can manage several moving pieces at once.
* Enjoys working with a team in person.
* Has enough confidence to take ownership while still being willing to learn.

Experience in marketing, communications, content, social media, events, client services, production, project coordination, or a related field is helpful.

**Recent graduates and early\-career professionals are encouraged to apply.**

**What Makes This Role Different**

You will not spend your day scheduling social posts.

You’ll get exposure to:

* founders and executives
* client strategy
* content development
* video production
* social media
* AI workflows
* project management
* digital products
* client experience

As your judgment grows, so will the responsibility.

The right person can eventually take greater ownership of LeaderPass content, manage selected client relationships, and participate more deeply in the work we create.

Position Details

**Full\-time**  
**In person, Peachtree Corners, Georgia**  
**$50,000–$60,000 base salary, based on experience**  
**Paid time off \+ company holidays**

LeaderPass helps experts and organizations turn expertise into the reason people trust, choose, and come back.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Application Question(s):

* Tell us about something you noticed needed to be done and took ownership of without being asked. What did you do?
* What is one brand, creator, or company whose content you think is especially good right now, and why?
* How have you used ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI tool in school, work, or a personal project?
* Tell us about a time you had several deadlines, people, or projects moving at once. How did you keep everything organized?
* This is a full\-time, in\-person role at our Peachtree Corners studio. You’ll work directly with clients, Blueprint Sessions, production, content creation, and our team, so being present is an important part of learning the role and doing it well.

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
